# Rainbow Shiksha

> Rainbow Shiksha is a registered non-profit NGO (founded 2013, officially registered 2025) dedicated to empowering underprivileged children through education support across India. Programs include stationery distribution, school fee assistance, computer/laptop donations, blind student support, and festive celebrations at orphanages.

## About

Rainbow Shiksha was started in May 2013 with the inspiration of Saanthwana Group. It was founded by Mallikarjuna M and is supported by a volunteer team spread across Hyderabad, Kurnool, Bangalore, and Guntur. The organisation was officially registered in October 2025.

**Mission:** Every child in India deserves access to quality education, regardless of their circumstances.

**Areas of work:** Hyderabad · Kurnool · Bangalore · Guntur · Karnataka · Andhra Pradesh · Telangana

## Journey Timeline (2013–2026)

- **May 2013** – Inception of Rainbow Shiksha, inspired by Saanthwana Group.
- **July 2014** – Distributed Vivekananda books on the occasion of Vivekananda's 150th Anniversary.
- **August 2015** – Paid one year school fee for Kiran (8th Class, GSNR Kurnool) and Shirisha (10th Class, Hyderabad).
- **July 2016** – Paid college exam fee and competitive exam fee for blind students.
- **January 2017** – Distributed stationery in Hyderabad, Kurnool, and Bangalore before annual exams.
- **April 2018** – Celebrated Diwali and Holi festivals in orphanages in Hyderabad.
- **May 2019** – Conducted General Knowledge exams and distributed gifts in government schools.
- **July 2020** – Celebrated Children's Day in an orphanage in Siddaganga, Tumkur.
- **February 2021** – Arranged food for blind students on Louis Braille's birthday anniversary.
- **May 2022** – Conducted games and education awareness at Mother Theresa Orphanage, Hyderabad.
- **June 2023** – Donated 3 computers and 2 laptops to an aided school in Karnataka.
- **September 2024** – Visited colleges to pay fees for blind students and helped retrieve certificates.
- **October 2025** – Rainbow Shiksha officially registered as a non-profit organisation.
- **February 2026** – Donated school bags to children in Guntur in collaboration with KBR Foundation.

## Impact

- 25+ children directly supported
- 5+ schools partnered
- ₹3 Lakh+ funds raised
- 2+ awards and recognition received
- 13 years of continuous service (2013–2026)

## How to Help

Donations accepted via UPI and bank transfer. Volunteers welcome — contact via the website or WhatsApp.
